اصطليت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَيْتُ (iṣṭalaytu) /isˤ.tˤa.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
# اِصْطَلَيْتَ (iṣṭalayta) /isˤ.tˤa.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
# اِصْطَلَيْتِ (iṣṭalayti) /isˤ.tˤa.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
